description: This file implements the LightsObserver class, which manages WebRTC-based lighting sessions, including connection handling, message reading, and client subscription management.

classes.name: LightsObserver
classes.description: Manages WebRTC lighting sessions, including connection lifecycle, message processing, and client subscriptions.

methods.name: LightsObserver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LightsObserver with network parameters and configuration.

methods.name: ~LightsObserver
methods.description: Destructor that ensures the connection thread is stopped properly.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the connection thread and begins listening for server messages.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the connection thread and disconnects from the server.

methods.name: ReadServerMessages
methods.description: Reads and processes messages from the server, updating session state and notifying clients.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers a new client callback for lighting updates and returns a client ID.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a client callback based on its ID.
